targets.authors: Kärnä, A., Voeten, M., Little, T. D., Poskiparta, E., Kaljonen, A., & Salmivalli, C.
targets.title: A large-scale evaluation of the KiVa antibullying program: Grades 4-6.
targets.evidence_quote: This study aimed to replicate the effectiveness-study of the KiVa antibullying program (Kärnä et al. 2011b;Salmivalli et al. 2010) in the Netherlands.
targets.outcome_quote: Taken together, our findings indicate that the KiVa antibullying program is successful in decreasing victimization and bullying in the Netherlands, with small effect sizes that are comparable with KiVa effects in other countries and the effects of other interventions.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall concluding verdict supports effectiveness; smaller effects are not treated as failure.
